summary: Standing Flathead NF lookout near Condon: 1933 L-4 first tower, 1968 R-6 tower; summer staffing by volunteers or DNRC (sources conflict).

visit.trail_note: Rumble Creek Road leads to a trailhead parking area a quarter mile past the lookout; this is a hiking trailhead, not a statement that the tower is open.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. The register says volunteers staff the tower in summer; firelookout.com says the Montana DNRC does; the 2016 chapter report credits volunteers. The sources may describe different years, so the story gives both.

notes_for_editor: No access level: nothing fetched says whether the tower can be entered. Staffing conflict is unresolved; the 2016 report is the only dated staffing source (its 2014 sister report was not read). Brief's R-6 design belongs to the 1968 tower; the 1933 first tower was L-4. Trail facts come from a Seeley Lake visitor page on the Rumble Creek Lakes hike, not a Forest Service source. A 1956 Forest Service photo caption mentions a Condon lookout tower but cannot be tied to Cooney, so it is omitted. Height 30 ft converted to 9.1 m.
